summary: New 95% C.L. TeV-transparency axion-photon exclusion from Fig. 4 of 2611.32905, correctly extracted in eV/GeV^-1 with canonical g_agamma convention. Representative points (g~2.3e-11 at ~10 eV; ~5e-12 at 10^3 eV) agree with the paper's figure and its 'competitive around m_a~10 eV' statement. Highlight and full views show the result faithfully.

verdict.summary: New 95% C.L. TeV-transparency axion-photon exclusion from Fig. 4 of 2611.32905, correctly extracted in eV/GeV^-1 with canonical g_agamma convention. Representative points (g~2.3e-11 at ~10 eV; ~5e-12 at 10^3 eV) agree with the paper's figure and its 'competitive around m_a~10 eV' statement. Highlight and full views show the result faithfully.

result_identity.evidence: Paper Fig. 4 (p.5) + Eq. 10: axion-photon coupling g_agamma vs m_a, 95% C.L. exclusion from TeV gamma-ray transparency (LHAASO GRB221009A + Greaux EBL). Extraction coupling_type AxionPhoton, g_agamma[GeV^-1] vs mass[eV] — matches.

novelty.evidence: Abstract and text (p.1-2): 'first TeV-transparency bounds' and 'derive the competitive limit on the axion-photon coupling'. These are exclusions (regions above boundaries), not projections (is_projection=false). A genuine new measured bound.

confidence_level.evidence: Fig. 4 titled '95% C.L. Exclusion Region' (p.5) and p.3 'We quote separate 95% exclusions based on the broad-band EBL reconstruction... and on the LHAASO spectrum'. Extraction confidence_level 0.95 is directly supported, not a placeholder.

conventions.evidence: Eq. 10 defines L = -(g_agamma/4) a F Fdual (canonical); units m_a[eV], g_agamma[GeV^-1] match AxionLimits. Bound assumes axions = all DM at recombination (p.5), a cosmological-abundance assumption independent of local halo density, so dm_density_assumed=null is appropriate. Plot method only fill_between above the traced g(m) curve; no hidden density/unit transform bypassed.

numerical_agreement.evidence: m_a=10.7 eV -> g=2.26e-11 matches paper's 'competitive around m_a~10 eV' (notes g~2.5e-11). Left edge (0.102 eV, 1.9e-8) and right edge (985 eV, 4.6e-12) consistent with Fig. 4 envelope descending ~10^-8 -> ~5e-12 (blue Greaux floor at high mass). Monotonic descent matches min(LHAASO,Greaux) envelope. Per-point tracing limited by the small embedded raster, but all representative anchors agree.

highlight_target.evidence: Highlighted PNG shows one red 'TeV Transparency' region (m_a 0.1-10^3, boundary 10^-8 down to ~5e-12), matching the extracted curve; no unrelated limit accented. Corresponding full view draws the same region.

visibility.evidence: Full AxionPhoton.png: region on-screen over m_a 0.1-10^3 eV with 'TeV Transparency' label at top; overlap with CAST/Solar nu is expected for an independent bound. Highlighted view renders boundaries clearly and interpretably.
